main_text.p: in omni concoctione suum sit excrementum; si retineatur diutius, necesse est in corpore contentum tandem putrescere, morbumque procreare, proinde sanitatis studiosus providere debet, ut mature expellatur. Similiter laeditur sanitas, si expellantur humores qui retineri alioqui debent, nisi peccent copia, & quantitate; tum enim, quia fluxiones concitant, minuendi sunt, sicut de plethora diximus antea. Idem est judicium & sanguinis menstrui, haemorrhoidum, lactis, seminis; quae etsi sola quantitate peccent, expelli tamen debent; alioqui sunt promptissimae morborum causae.

Quod dico conspicuum est in femine; nam diutius retentum, quod a castis viduis, puellisque fit, plurima inducit symptomata. corrumpitur enim, affectumque parit hystericum. Moderatus veneris usus corpus reddit vegetum & alacre; immoderatus vires exhaurit, corpus refrigerat, nervosque debilitat &c. Ætas veneri aptissima

page.notes: Printed text is set in the old long-s style; long s was normalised to s. Some words are rendered from a slightly blurred scan: "fit" in "puellisque fit", "corrumpitur" and "nervosque" are the likeliest readings. The line "aptissima" is set flush right at the foot of the column. Catchword: none visible.
